I'd suggest [Geocaching](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geocaching). It's basically a worldwide scavenger hunt based on GPS coordinates. You look on a website (a popular site is by far the most common) and find a set of coordinates. Then you go to those coordiates (some are miles of hiking into the wilderness, others are feet away from a parking area in an urban setting) and look for the "cache" (usually either an ammo box, or a tupperwear container). Once you find the cache you can sign the logbook signifying your find, take and leave a little item (things like matchbox cars are popular) and log your find on the website. There's a great sense of pride in finding something that is hidden from most people, and the "premium" version of the website/app only costs like $30 per year, making it an extremely inexpensive hobby to get into.
